motion.name: orbit
motion.purpose: Decorative hero signal only; disabled for reduced motion.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main page action on the hero.
components.css: .ds-primary { background: var(--signal); color: var(--signal-foreground); border: 0; border-radius: 9999px; padding: 12px 24px; font-weight: 700; min-height: 48px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-primary:hover { filter: brightness(.95); } .ds-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--signal); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Quiet action on a dark surface.
components.css: .ds-secondary { background: transparent; color: var(--hero-foreground); border: 1px solid rgb(255 255 255 / .25); border-radius: 9999px; padding: 12px 24px; min-height: 48px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-secondary:hover { background: rgb(255 255 255 / .1); } .ds-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--signal); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Navigation Link
components.css: .ds-nav { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 40px; padding: 0 16px; border-radius: 9999px; color: var(--muted-foreground); text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav:hover { background: var(--muted); color: var(--foreground); } .ds-nav:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ring); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Content Card
components.css: .ds-card { background: var(--card); color: var(--card-foreground); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 20px; padding: 24px; }

components.name: Topic Badge
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 28px; border-radius: 9999px; padding: 4px 12px; background: var(--secondary); color: var(--secondary-foreground); font: 600 12px 'DM Sans Variable', sans-serif; }

narrative.overview: A dark event stage meets a clear editorial layout. Lime marks the date and the next action. Orbital geometry evokes ideas finding one another without pretending to depict confirmed people or a venue.

rules.name: One signal
rules.body: Use lime for the countdown and primary action; let other surfaces stay calm.

donts: Invent confirmed speakers or venue details.
Add decorative motion to every section.
